description: List the phone numbers in your workspace that have voice compliance runs: one row per number with a summary (tests ran, passed, failed, counting the latest run of each catalogue test) and lastRunAt. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks which numbers have been audited for compliance, or how a number is doing overall. For one number's full report use getComplianceReportByPhone. For chat bots use listDigitalComplianceAudits. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listComplianceReports
title: List Voice Compliance Reports
